This session alone: an onset-swing metric returned 0.0 for 'no voiced frames' (reads as flawless) and flagged his own recordings as the wobbliest files in the set. When his ear and a number disagree, the number is wrong until proven otherwise.

Fabio: 'if it's in history, it's in history... as long as it's not there on master after we finished'. They cannot reach a user - builds package the working tree. Do not propose a filter-repo.
AGE DIES AT THE CHATTERBOX TTS STEP, NOT THE VC STEP, so 80-90 is unreachable synthetically while 60-70 is reliable. Pitch is NOT the age cue - matching his 215.6 Hz source produced 'young men'.

THE VC INTERMEDIATES ARE THROWAWAY. Fabio heard 'huge pitch oscillations' in them; they are trimmed to 2 s as a TTS reference and never ship. A stage-by-stage wobble measure showed the three library targets are NOT outliers, so no shipped voice needs re-rolling.
